title: A Recommendation Is Not Authorization Or Implementation
summary: A map separating evidence translation, institutional choice, decision ownership, authority, conditions, resources, capacity, milestones, safeguards, accepted output, and public accountability.
map_question: What must be documented between a bounded recommendation and a reviewable implementation commitment?
interpretation_boundary: A recommendation does not select an accountable institution, create authority, commit resources, establish delivery capacity, satisfy conditions, complete a milestone, or prove accepted operation.

nodes.label: Phase 74 decision translation
nodes.note: No Phase 74 translation has been adjudicated.

nodes.label: Complete option set and status quo
nodes.note: Available choices, exclusions, benefits, harms, distribution, and feasibility remain explicit.

nodes.label: Named decision owner
nodes.note: The accountable institution, person, duty, conflict, recusal, and replacement authority are versioned.

nodes.label: Current authority
nodes.note: Legal, policy, fiscal, and operating authority are independently verified.

nodes.label: Selection rationale and dissent
nodes.note: Evidence, values, uncertainty, conflicts, proportionality, and minority positions remain attached.

nodes.label: Authorization with terms
nodes.note: Conditions, monitoring, safeguards, review, and sunset define the permission boundary.

nodes.label: Versioned implementation commitment
nodes.note: Owner, scope, beneficiaries, budget, workforce, assets, and amendments are fixed.

nodes.label: Resource and capacity baseline
nodes.note: Available funding, staff, facilities, data, suppliers, and institutional capacity are dated.

nodes.label: Milestones and dependencies
nodes.note: Scheduled, initiated, completed, tested, accepted, and operating states remain separate.

nodes.label: Safeguard and stop-work controls
nodes.note: Thresholds, owners, evidence duties, pause, reversal, and remedy paths are explicit.

nodes.label: Accepted output
nodes.note: No Phase 75 accepted implementation output exists.

links.note: No accountable institutional actor has selected an option.
Ownership and authority are separate checks.
Authority cannot substitute for a transparent rationale.
No authorization instrument or receipt exists.
Authorization does not create an implementation commitment.
No resource or capacity baseline exists.
Delivery cannot bypass safeguard and stop-work terms.
No output has been delivered or accepted.

what_this_map_supports: Sixteen accountability gates and sixteen implementation-and-realization gates.
Visible separation between recommendation, institutional decision, authorization, commitment, capacity, milestones, safeguards, and accepted output.
Append-only amendment, dissent, conflict, recusal, condition, and receipt lineage.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish a recommendation, decision owner, authority, selected option, rationale, authorization, commitment, resource, milestone, or output.
It does not establish implementation quality, accepted service, benefit, harm, equity, contribution, attribution, or net benefit.
It does not create a score, rank, forecast, automatic authorization, automatic stage advance, or silent renewal.
next_records_needed: A real Phase 74 translation receipt and versioned recommendation.
A named decision owner, current authority record, option rationale, dissent archive, and authorization instrument.
A versioned implementation commitment with resources, capacity, milestones, safeguards, and acceptance criteria.
